text:
Situation: Tramadol hydrochloride 50 mg tablets are low at both campuses. Corvale East holds 303 units at 18.1 units per day, giving 17 days of supply. Corvale General holds 532 units at 18.4 units per day, giving 29 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): The labeler for NDC 50090578902 is A-S Medication Solutions (FEI 1450743). FDA issued a Warning Letter to A-S Medication Solutions LLC on 2017-06-05 (case 522197). The most recent inspection of this facility ended on 2026-08-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2026-10-14. Prior inspections in 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2018 were also classified VAI. Tramadol hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than one month at Corvale East and about one month at Corvale General. No FDA shortage listing exists. The labeler’s facility has a history of VAI classifications and a 2017 Warning Letter. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Advagen Pharma Limited (plant: Rubicon Research Limited, last inspection NAI 2024-03-08). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Aurobindo Pharma Limited (plant: Aurobindo Pharma Limited, last inspection VAI 2022-05-10). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with American Health Packaging. Approval: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock reaches critical levels.
